verdict.rationale: Datadog is an observability platform, so user-configurable background automations are a fair question for it. However, the pack contains only page titles (Monitors, Watchdog, Bits AI, Kubernetes Autoscaling) with no content describing user-defined automations, workflows or scheduled jobs that run autonomously. Monitors and Watchdog are alerting and anomaly-detection features, which are adjacent but not evidenced as automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
